required_candidate_3_scope: Correct the documented prefill-time ratio direction and add an asymmetric regression vector.
Bind evaluated token counts to an independent production-derived prompt count and the 32,768 context envelope; reject inflated counts.
Validate every frozen campaign artifact and bind the live child environment, command line, binary and model identity rather than trusting runtime.config.
Move the full model digest out of individual arms; use stable dev:ino:size identity across launch/readiness/completion without asymmetric cache preconditioning.
Record and require complete idle pre/post state including both engine names and the campaign listener.
Split model-supported and measured campaign context fields.

convergence.reason: This is the first consecutive candidate without strict shrinkage. The enumerated escalation trigger requires two consecutive non-shrinking candidates. Candidate 3 is bounded to the named round-315 findings.
